subject: Hosted API integration architecture review / technical deep-dive - scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API integration architecture review / deep-dive

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood Hosted API looks promising. Our engineering team (Samir and I) would like to schedule a technical deep-dive specifically focused on integration architecture: SDK options, streaming behavior, and tool/function calling patterns for our ingestion/agent use cases.

High-level goals:
- Understand SDK language support and best practices for long-lived streams
- How function/tool calling (and verification) works end-to-end
- Network/security considerations for hosted API + prefix/kv caching expectations

Ideal attendees from your side: an architect or senior engineer familiar with the runtime and an SDK engineer. From our side we'll bring our lead backend engineer and ML engineer.

Can you share a few 60-minute slots next week? We prefer mornings PT. Also, would appreciate any pre-read (architecture doc or short slides).

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Director of Engineering, Acme Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review / deep-dive

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear goals. Happy to set this up.

Proposed 60-min slots (PT):
- Tue Mar 3, 9:30–10:30am
- Tue Mar 3, 11:00–12:00pm
- Wed Mar 4, 9:00–10:00am

Attendees from Redwood: Neha (runtime/serving), Dev (SDK & streaming), and I'll join for product-level items.

I've attached a short architecture overview (redwood-hosted-api-architecture.pdf) and a proposed agenda (proposed-agenda.md) to help you pick the right slot. If you prefer a different time, say which one and we'll reschedule.

Agenda (high-level):
1) 10 min — intros & goals
2) 20 min — runtime/serving architecture (Neha)
3) 20 min — SDKs, streaming & function calling patterns (Dev)
4) 10 min — Q/A & next steps

Let me know which slot works and I'll send a calendar invite with the dial-in and pre-reads.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review / deep-dive

Hi Marissa — thanks for the options. All three look possible but can we avoid Tue 11am? That conflicts with a product review. Our preferred slot is Tue Mar 3, 9:30–10:30am PT. If that fills up, Wed 9am PT is OK.

One request: can Dev cover implementation patterns for streaming partial updates (we plan to stream embeddings/results into our pipeline) and the correct/expected retry/backoff strategy for persistent streams? Also, are there any size/latency tradeoffs we should be aware of for long-lived sessions?

Thanks,
Samir
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@acme-analytics.com>, Samir Rao <samir@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review / deep-dive

Thanks for locking this in — adding a couple of notes for the session:

- Dev: please prepare a brief code walkthrough (Python + Node) showing a streaming session that emits intermediate outputs and a minimal function-calling example for safe tool invocation.
- I'll cover runtime internals: batching, KV cache, and how we select kernels for long sequence workloads.
- Rafael: please include the sample network diagram for hosted connections (I attached acme-data-flow.drawio.png).

Also, Alex/Samir — could you confirm the list of attendees from your side (names + roles) so we can tailor the depth of the walkthrough?

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@acme-analytics.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review / deep-dive

Marissa / team — confirmed. We'll attend:
- Alex Chen — Director of Engineering (integration owner)
- Samir Rao — Lead Backend Engineer (streams & reliability)
- Lena Ortiz — ML Engineer (agent orchestration)

Thanks for the pre-reads — the architecture doc looks helpful. We've accepted the Tue Mar 3 9:30am PT invite but had to move it to Wed Mar 4 9:00am PT due to internal conflict (your calendar should show the updated invite). The confirmed time for Redwood <-> Acme deep-dive: Wed Mar 4, 9:00–10:00am PT.

Looking forward to a focused session on streaming patterns and function calling safety.

Best,
Alex
